analogs.covers: Almost everything: harems in a big flock, running endurance, powerful kicks, sentinel eyes, tagging along with grazing herds

headline: An ostrich flock: harems of hens, incredible running endurance, powerful kicks and the best eyes in the herd.

setting.label: Vast open lands, alongside other herbivore herds
setting.note: Nomadic and loves traversing vast lands. Often follows other herbivore herds and may settle with Deinocheirus, learning to bathe.

playsLike: You are a small, extremely fast herbivore: sprint 1,150 held for 323 s, one of the longest land sprints on the roster. You live in a flock of harems, each with 1 male and up to 4 hens. You always flee Large-or-bigger carnivores, but kick small or lone carnivores to death, especially baby carnivores; up to 5 of you engage. In mixed herds you grow bold and serve as the lookout, until a predator targets you and you hide behind your herdmates.

why.text: 1 male and up to 4 hens per harem inside a large flock. Ostrich males keep several hens too (official inspiration: ratites).
Its stamina and a 680 trot make it a marathon runner, just like the ostrich.
'Primarily relies on their powerful kicks' both to attack and to defend.
Renowned as a sentry that nearby herbivores rely on. Zebras and antelope use ostriches as lookouts the same way.
Follows other herbivore herds for safety and pecks up stones as gastroliths, as ostriches swallow stones to grind food.

notLike: An ostrich is a giant among birds; Struthiomimus is Small tier (1,400 combat weight) on this roster and has to run.
twist: Emu, rhea and cassowary are official inspirations too.
